reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:43f3873725d0ffe56a228d217c6fa977]] Despite  my splotchiness,  I love this!!  I am NOT the best at eyeliner.  Quite frankly I suck at makeup all together!  This little tool really made it a lot easier for me.  I just gotta steady my hand more and keep practicing!  Once I've used  it a few times  I'm going to come back  and update my review ^_^  Update: absolutely worth my money!  No smudging and long lasting!!

reviews.t: Creates beautiful wings with a little practice.
reviews.x: This makes drawing wings a snap! You have to work with it a little. Too much pressure and it stamps too much product which creates a mess. Too little pressure and it’s not a clean line. You also have to make sure you hold the angle correctly on each side. Otherwise you have one higher wing and one lower wing. Overall it’s cut my wing application in half and looks much better than if I freehand it!

This stuff is awesome. It hard to perfect the cat eye. Especially, if you are in your 30’s or 40’s and you have some fine lines around your eyes. You draw a straight line, with one end, then kinda use the other end as a “stamp”. It really works. Best I’ve found yet.

I needed new eyeliner. I saw all of the reviews of young girls with extensive eyeliner and that is not how I use it. So I did not know if the stamp for the extended part at the corner that they refer to as a “cat eye” was going to work for me or be too much. The price was  right so I ordered it. I am thrilled with how easy to use this eyeliner is! I did the stamp in the side corner of each eye, then applied  the lines on the two top lids, then bottom of both eyes. reviews.t: Bye ratchet stye!!! I hate you
reviews.x: Ok most eyeliners run on me because I have sensitive oily eyes and I tend to get styes often. So far no stye or runny eye makeup even after shedding a few tears 😢!! I use the mascara as well.

I was able to wipe off my first few tries w a plain, slightly wet tissue - wet w WATER ONLY - and when I woke up this morning - WITHOUT having removed my eye makeup last nite - the eyeliner, the wing stamps, ALL OF IT - just GONE. Clearly cheaply made, and naturally I threw it away immediately but they won’t refund me unless I return sooo I guess that’s just money down the literal drain. Very unimpressed, and I was so excited to try this.

reviews.t: Arrived totally dry on stamp side
reviews.x: Stamp side totally dried out from day 1 arrival. It's an inconvenience but I use another liquid liner to fill in the dry stamp & use it that way, but I'd much rather have a working product that I paid for. Even if it was only 5 bucks. I thought it would be 2 stamps like most others that have the left flick & then the right, but it's just a straight flick so you can use it on either side. I find it easier to place properly & evenly at the proper angle to match both sides up than the ones with des

i was really surprised by how well the stamp worked from the first try. i got a perfect cat-eye in a second so it is user friendly. It does smudge a little and i had to reapply the eyeliner because i like a bold look. Overall, I am happy that it does the job of applying the cat-eye look flawlessly. The first order i was lost but Amazon replaced it.

This is my first time ever attempting to do eyeliner and I say this turned out pretty good. It was very easy to use. For someone beginning to do eyeliner or struggling to do their eyeliner, I would recommend.

I did not expect a $4 eyeliner to be that great. I thought it would just get me through till I could go to Ulta and buy a name brand eyeliner, little did I know, I’d want to stick with this instead. I used this eyeliner and immediately fell in love. It even passed the “nap test”, because my eyes always water when I nap, I usually wake up with streaks in my eyeliner, but when I woke up, this liner looks like I put it on 5 minutes ago! It’s worth the 4 bucks, you won’t regret it!

I really like this product! I am the worst at eyeliner. I can never get it how I want it. The first time I tried this product (pictured) I was obsessed. It stayed on, didn’t smudge, and the color was perfect and intense. I’ve tried to use it since then but I just can’t get my wings in the exact same spot and perfectly even, so I’m still working on it. However, this product is so easy to use that I am sure I’ll get get used to it soon.

I got this for Christmas and it's absolutely awful. It's watery and is not pigmented at all. The stamp doesn't even have color on it; if I wanted to use the stamp I'd need to cover it with another eyeliner. Huge disappointment. It's a good thing it's cheap because I'd hate to know my mom spent money on this.  The cat eye is what I stamped and drew in with the pen, and the stamp underneath that looks like a smudge is the actual stamp.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the stamp easy to use and helpful for creating winged or cat-eye looks, especially for beginners or those who struggle with eyeliner.
Several reviewers report the product stays on well and doesn't run, even for those with sensitive or oily eyes.
Some reviewers complain the product is messy, with ink leaking or pouring out on opening.
A few reviewers report the stamp side arrived dry or that the product crumbles and doesn't last.
Some reviewers note it is not waterproof and can smudge or wipe off easily.
